title: 'Sorry you feel that way' isn't an apology.
old_caption:
Has anyone ever told you they are sorry you feel that way?
Libra says that is not an apology. Name what you did, then say sorry.

title: Splitting the bill on date one is fine.
old_caption:
Who pays on the first date?
There's no rule, just respect. Ask, then split or treat.

title: Houston summer is hotter than Miami summer.
old_caption:
Which summer is hotter: Houston or Miami?
The stars call it a tie. Bring water, and someone to share the AC with.

title: Your sun sign is the least interesting part of you.
old_caption:
Is your sun sign really the whole story?
The Sun, Moon and Rising all argue for the spotlight. You're a whole chart.

title: Surprise parties are for the planner.
old_caption:
Would you love a surprise party or quietly dread it?
Virgo and Leo learn to know your person and surprise them their way.

title: Talking stage over a month? Just ask.
old_caption:
Day 41 of the talking stage and still no label?
Clarity is kind, and "what are we?" is a fair question. You're allowed to ask.

title: Taurus isn't stubborn. It's loyal.
old_caption:
Ever been called stubborn when you were just being steady?
Taurus shows it can stay loyal and still step toward someone new.

title: Texting back fast isn't desperate.
old_caption:
Worried that replying fast makes you look too keen?
Games make tired people. Reply when you can and mean it.

title: Small daily effort beats one grand gesture.
old_caption:
Billboard-size romance or one sticky note every day?
Taurus says small daily effort beats a grand gesture. Show up on Tuesday.

title: In Houston, 20 minutes away is long distance.
old_caption:
Is 20 minutes away basically long distance in your city?
Meet in the middle and take turns driving. Literally.
